LanguageData.FH_Berserk.label: flesh berserk
LanguageData.FH_Berserk.description: The flesh beasts are driven into a frenzied berserk state.
LanguageData.FH_Berserk.stages.berserk.label: berserk
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Furiousmeld.label: furiousmeld parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Furiousmeld.description: The furiousmeld latches onto the host, providing twisted flesh capacity, armor, and regeneration.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Bastionmeld.label: bastionmeld parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Bastionmeld.description: The bastionmeld latches onto the host, grafting two parasitic weapon mounts onto the body and allowing the host to release an EMP pulse.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Fissionmeld.label: fissionmeld parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Fissionmeld.description: The fissionmeld latches onto the host, grafting bone spikes, increasing twisted flesh capacity, granting regeneration, and allowing the host to prepare a flesh rebirth.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Nexusmeld.label: nexusmeld parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Nexusmeld.description: The nexusmeld latches onto the host, providing twisted flesh capacity, regeneration, and strengthening all friendly flesh beasts.
LanguageData.FH_Unification.label: flesh unification
LanguageData.FH_Unification.description: The nexusmeld's psychic unity strengthens the flesh. Melee damage increased, incoming damage reduced.
